purpose: Composes a structured verification-failure/fraud-attempt incident record from an IDV/KYC session for fraud teams, regulators, and insurers: a cross-link to the session's hash-chained receipt (art-359), an honest failure classification (type + AR4SI severity tier), session evidence digests, remediation status, and an optional cross-link to an escalation record or a signed failure receipt. Reuses the art-379 agent-incident-record shape and vocabulary. A missing session-receipt link degrades the record's claim strength rather than being silently accepted, and a malformed cross-link hash is flagged, not hidden. This is an evidence format for an incident the caller declares, not a fraud-detection system, not a determination of fault, and not a regulatory or insurance adjudication. Zero network, zero PII.
